span.label: mechanisms

span.label: mechanisms

span.label: mechanisms

span.label: mechanisms

span.label: and the frequency itself is set by the balance of drive - in simulations gamma frequency INCREASED WITH INCREASED EXCITATORY DRIVE onto the interneurons and DECREASED WITH INCREASED GABA CONDUCTANCES

span.label: The evidence base is overwhelmingly rodent, because deep human hippocampal rhythm measurement is hard
span.note: what this limits: the transfer of every finding to humans: MANY OF THE FINDINGS DESCRIBED HERE HAVE BEEN MADE IN STUDIES CARRIED OUT IN LOWER MAMMALS, PARTICULARLY RODENTS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The proposed mechanisms for slow versus fast gamma generation are explicitly provisional
span.note: what this limits: the mechanistic account of slow versus fast gamma: THESE HYPOTHESES ARE TENTATIVE, AND MUCH WORK REMAINS TO BE DONE
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Findings on slow gamma do not all fit the memory-retrieval account the review favours
span.note: what this limits: the memory-retrieval account of slow gamma: THESE APPARENT INCONGRUITIES ACROSS STUDIES HIGHLIGHT THE NEED FOR FURTHER INVESTIGATION - not all findings fit it
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: MOST OF THE STUDIES DESCRIBED ABOVE DID NOT DIFFERENTIATE BETWEEN DIFFERENT FREQUENCY VARIANTS OF GAMMA, and IT IS POSSIBLE THAT SLOW AND FAST GAMMA ARE GENERATED BY DIFFERENT MECHANISMS

span.label: the observed ~20-40 Hz activity OVERLAPPED WITH BOTH BETA AND SLOW GAMMA FREQUENCY BANDS and thus MAY REFLECT EITHER BETA, SLOW GAMMA, OR A COMBINATION OF BOTH
span.note: what this limits: the band assignment of that result, and of the band vocabulary generally: the ~20-40 Hz coupling OVERLAPPED WITH BOTH BETA AND SLOW GAMMA FREQUENCY BANDS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE HIGH VARIABILITY OF GAMMA FREQUENCY ALSO COMPLICATES ITS MEASUREMENT IN BEHAVING ANIMALS
span.note: what this limits: every gamma measurement in behaving animals: THE HIGH VARIABILITY OF GAMMA FREQUENCY ALSO COMPLICATES ITS MEASUREMENT

span.label: these hypotheses are TENTATIVE, and MUCH WORK REMAINS TO BE DONE to uncover mechanisms underlying slow and fast gamma rhythms

Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the precise role of HCN channels REMAINS UNCLEAR because ENHANCED theta rhythms occur in HCN1 knockout mice, where the channel was thought to FACILITATE theta
span.note: what this limits: the HCN account of theta: HCN1 IS THOUGHT TO FACILITATE THETA RHYTHMIC FIRING, yet ENHANCED theta rhythms occur in HCN1 knockout mice - the review carries both

span.note: THE RELATION FAILS: the review reports that results do not support a memory-encoding function for fast gamma, and that a study found it linked to working memory BUT NOT memory encoding. span.label: theta frequency → functional significance
span.note: DECLARED OPEN BY THE REVIEW: 'some important questions remain ... Quotation withheld Specifically, is there any functional significance to the LOWER FREQUENCY OF THETA that occurs during novel experiences compared to familiar ones?' A relation the field has not established, stated as a question. Every edge type asserts that a relation HOLDS.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE OBJECT IS DEFINED BY FREQUENCY AND JUDGED BY FUNCTION: these rhythms ARE DEFINED BY THEIR FREQUENCIES, have behavioral correlates, and HAVE BEEN PROPOSED TO PERFORM DISTINCT FUNCTIONS - HOWEVER, RECENT FINDINGS HAVE CHALLENGED TRADITIONAL VIEWS ON THESE BEHAVIORAL FUNCTIONS
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the assignment is stated as an expectation rather than a result: each rhythm is observed during particular behaviors and generated by specific mechanisms, so IT IS THEREFORE NOT SURPRISING THAT THESE DIFFERENT RHYTHMS ARE THOUGHT TO PERFORM DISTINCT FUNCTIONS - with THERE IS LESS AGREEMENT IN THE FIELD ABOUT THE FUNCTIONAL SIGNIFICANCE OF GAMMA
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A LIVE NAMING CONFLICT SETTLED IN A PARENTHESIS: the same activity HAS BEEN TERMED FAST GAMMA IN SOME STUDIES AND MIDFREQUENCY GAMMA IN OTHERS - (THE FORMER TERMINOLOGY WILL BE USED HERE). One review, one clause, and the field's vocabulary is decided for the reader
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND THE EARLIER LITERATURE COULD NOT HAVE TOLD THEM APART: MOST OF THE STUDIES DESCRIBED ABOVE DID NOT DIFFERENTIATE BETWEEN DIFFERENT FREQUENCY VARIANTS OF GAMMA, and IT IS POSSIBLE THAT SLOW AND FAST GAMMA ARE GENERATED BY DIFFERENT MECHANISMS - a whole mechanism literature written with one word for two things

span.label: A RESULT THAT CANNOT BE ASSIGNED TO A CATEGORY BECAUSE THE CATEGORIES OVERLAP: the observed ~20-40 Hz activity OVERLAPPED WITH BOTH BETA AND SLOW GAMMA FREQUENCY BANDS AND THUS MAY REFLECT EITHER BETA, SLOW GAMMA, OR A COMBINATION OF BOTH

span.label: and the second range printed where a layer difference is being claimed: SLOW GAMMA (~30-80 Hz) ACTIVITY DOMINATED IN STRATUM RADIATUM, WHEREAS ~60-100 Hz GAMMA DOMINATED IN STRATUM LACUNOSUM-MOLECULARE - the two definitions overlap by 20 Hz

span.label: with the measurement problem named as a property of the object: THE HIGH VARIABILITY OF GAMMA FREQUENCY ALSO COMPLICATES ITS MEASUREMENT IN BEHAVING ANIMALS
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A FOUNDING THEORY CALLED INTO QUESTION BY ONE STUDY: in the 1970s the extent to which theta was present PREDICTED HOW QUICKLY ANIMALS LEARNED, which LED TO THE THEORY that theta plays an essential role in learning and memory - HOWEVER, THE THEORY HAS BEEN CALLED INTO QUESTION
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the evidence is two facts that no amount of theta-learning correlation can absorb: place fields WERE FORMED in novel environments DESPITE THETA BEING BLOCKED by septal inactivation, and FLYING BATS HAVE PLACE CELLS EVEN THOUGH these cells exhibit LITTLE TO NO THETA RHYTHMICITY - so THETA RHYTHMICITY IS NOT REQUIRED FOR THE FORMATION OF PLACE FIELDS
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE REVIEW'S STRUCTURE IS THE ARGUMENT: several studies have begun to address whether slow and fast gamma perform different functions, A FEW MAIN HYPOTHESES HAVE EMERGED, and EVIDENCE FOR AND AGAINST EACH OF THESE HYPOTHESES IS DISCUSSED BELOW
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and both hypotheses survive with their counter-evidence attached: HOWEVER, Quotation withheld - one study links it to WORKING MEMORY, BUT NOT MEMORY ENCODING
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and for the other: NOT ALL FINDINGS FROM STUDIES OF SLOW GAMMA FIT WITH THIS MEMORY RETRIEVAL HYPOTHESIS - THESE APPARENT INCONGRUITIES ACROSS STUDIES HIGHLIGHT THE NEED FOR FURTHER INVESTIGATION
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A MECHANISM THAT CONTRADICTS ITSELF IN TWO CITATIONS: HCN1 IS THOUGHT TO FACILITATE theta rhythmic firing and its blockade REDUCED theta entrainment - HOWEVER, THE PRECISE ROLE OF HCN CHANNELS REMAINS UNCLEAR BECAUSE IT HAS ALSO BEEN REPORTED THAT ENHANCED THETA RHYTHMS OCCUR IN HCN1 KNOCKOUT MICE
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and a pacemaker that turns out not to be necessary in vitro but necessary in vivo: THETA RHYTHMS CAN OCCUR IN THE ABSENCE OF MS PACEMAKER INPUTS in a whole hippocampal preparation, suggesting theta CAN ALSO EMERGE FROM LOCAL CIRCUIT INTERACTIONS - NONETHELESS, IT IS CLEAR THAT MS INPUTS ARE IMPORTANT for driving theta in behaving animals
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: with the clean two-circuit story qualified by the cells themselves: A SUBSTANTIAL PROPORTION OF CA1 INTERNEURONS PHASE-LOCK TO BOTH SLOW AND FAST GAMMA, and MAY BE PART OF A NETWORK THAT CAN GENERATE EITHER, DEPENDING ON THE STATE OF THE NETWORK
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the frequency is a consequence of drive rather than an identity: gamma frequency INCREASED WITH INCREASED EXCITATORY DRIVE onto the interneurons and DECREASED WITH INCREASED GABA CONDUCTANCES - which means the label follows the input, not the circuit
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: with the mechanism section closing on its own status: HOWEVER, THESE HYPOTHESES ARE TENTATIVE, AND MUCH WORK REMAINS TO BE DONE
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE OBJECT IS VISIBLE ONLY WHERE IT IS SYNCHRONOUS: rhythms reflect synchronized activity BECAUSE SYNCHRONOUS CURRENTS SUM TOGETHER to generate large-amplitude fluctuations, WHEREAS NON-SYNCHRONIZED CURRENTS DO NOT SUM AND THUS REMAIN TOO SMALL TO BE DETECTED - the measurement selects what it can see
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the region was chosen for the same reason: the hippocampus contains DENSELY PACKED NEURONS THAT GENERATE LARGE LFPs, especially CA1 because THE PYRAMIDAL CELL DENDRITES ARE ALIGNED IN PARALLEL - ACCORDINGLY, MANY STUDIES of the role of brain rhythms in memory HAVE BEEN CONDUCTED IN THE HIPPOCAMPUS
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the species too: many findings are from LOWER MAMMALS, PARTICULARLY RODENTS, IN PART BECAUSE THE MEASUREMENT of brain rhythms in healthy human subjects WITHIN A DEEP-LYING STRUCTURE such as the hippocampus IS DIFFICULT
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE OPEN QUESTIONS ARE LISTED AS OPEN: what exactly IS the functional significance of variations in theta frequency, and WHY WOULD MEMORIES BE STORED OR CONSOLIDATED IN REVERSE ORDER? DO FORWARD AND REVERSE REPLAY SERVE DIFFERENT FUNCTIONS?
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: with a gap at the center of the leading hypothesis: according to the consolidation hypothesis replay TRANSFERS MEMORIES FROM THE HIPPOCAMPUS TO THE NEOCORTEX, HOWEVER IT REMAINS UNKNOWN WHETHER COORDINATED SEQUENCE REPLAY OCCURS between the hippocampus and its major downstream target
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the question this whole review turns on, asked last: DO DIFFERENT FREQUENCIES OF GAMMA REPRESENT DIFFERENT FUNCTIONAL STATES, AND IF SO, ARE DIFFERENT CIRCUITS INVOLVED IN THEIR GENERATION OR IS THE SAME CIRCUITRY SIMPLY ENTRAINED BY DIFFERENT INPUTS?
